_readme: EVERY WORD OF THE RIDER LIVES HERE. Edit this file, run `node press-kit/build-all.mjs`,
and public/downloads/morphics-rider.pdf is reissued. No HTML, no code.
The build refuses rather than printing a broken document, and names the field.
Text formatting (works in any text field):
**bold**    -> white bold, for the words a promoter must not miss
*accent*    -> the green accent (used in the cover title)
~normal~    -> cancels bold inside a bold cell, e.g. "2 ~(4 pref.)~"
Type & < > ' " normally. They are escaped for you.
Placeholders, filled from src/data/epk.json so they can never go stale:
{contact} {company} {email} {phone} {updated}
Section numbers (01, 02, ...) are counted automatically in the order the
sections appear. Add, delete or reorder a section and everything renumbers.
A section is { title, blocks: [] }. A block is ONE of:
{ "p": "a paragraph" }
{ "list": ["bullet", "bullet"] }
{ "note": "the boxed, green-ruled callout" }
{ "checklist": ["tick box", "tick box"] }
cols sets each column's style: "f" = white bold label, "q" = narrow
number column, "" = ordinary. A row is either ["cell", "cell"] or
{ "key": true, "cells": [...] } to shade it as a must-have.
Keep to three pages, and keep no page half empty — the layout is built for
that. If a page overflows, the PDF will show it.

page1.intro: Morphics performs three ways. **All three are offered on every booking** — confirm which at advance; the requirements below apply only to the one chosen. This rider is executed with the performance contract and the Purchaser is bound by each clause collectively and independently.

head: Format
Artist provides
Venue provides
rows: Laptop, controllers, audio interface, all visual content and playback
2× balanced line input (DI or XLR), projector or LED wall with a feed, monitor
Laptop, controllers, audio interface. Audio routed from the artist's own interface
2× balanced line input (DI or XLR) and a monitor. Nothing else
Linked CDJ setup as specified overleaf, and a monitor

page1.note: **Flexibility is the default.** The rig adapts to the room — if the house cannot meet a spec, say so at advance rather than on the day and it can almost always be worked around. What matters is a clean stereo feed into a capable system and enough monitoring to play to.

list: A competent, experienced sound engineer on site from sound-check through the entire set.
System loud and clear enough for the room, with real low end and no bleed from other stages.

One monitor minimum, two preferred, on stands and adjustable from the position played. Placed left and right of the artist, **within about a metre** — not on the floor, and not behind. Where only one can be provided it goes on the **artist's left**, facing the audience.
A stable, structurally safe performance area at a **booth height of 90–100 cm**, and a fan for the booth.

blocks.p: The Artist reserves the right to refuse equipment judged unfit, unsafe or outside these specifications, and to have people removed from the stage during the performance.

head: Qty
DJ set — required equipment
Notes

cells: CDJ-2000NXS2 accepted. USB and Ethernet must be functional.

rows: Netgear ProSAFE GS105 or similar, linking all CDJs.

blocks.note: Decks and mixer must LINK, with working USB and Ethernet — the set is prepared as a linked multi-deck performance. A four-deck layout needs roughly **2200 mm** of stable table; two decks fit comfortably in less. Where a venue cannot provide this, the **Ableton format needs only two line inputs** and is the simpler booking.

page2.intro: Plan view. The booth footprint is the same for all three formats — only what sits on it changes. Green marks what the artist brings or what the house is asked to patch. **Advancing production:** {contact}, {email} · {phone}.

head: Format
Source
To house
rows: 2× balanced line (DI or XLR) + video feed to projector or LED

blocks.note: Booth width is the one thing worth confirming early: a four-deck layout needs roughly **2200 mm** of stable table, two decks fit comfortably in less. Say which you can host at advance and the set is prepared for it.

blocks.p: Content is supplied and played back by the artist; the house provides the surface and the feed to it.

list: Projector or LED wall, **1920 × 1080 minimum**, 16:9, at **50 or 60 Hz**.
**HDMI** from the booth position. Where the run is long, the venue provides the cable or an HDMI-over-Cat extender. **SDI is accepted** where the house standard — the venue supplies the converter.
Screen behind or above the performance position, not in front of it, with a sightline to it from the booth.
**Screen mapping, edge blending and pixel alignment are the venue's**, not the artist's. The artist delivers one clean 16:9 feed; how it lands on the surface is the house system's job.
Where the venue runs its own VJ or house visuals, the artist can supply content to them instead — say so at advance.
The set plays without visuals if the room cannot host them; the A/V format simply becomes the Ableton format.

page3.title: Terms, logistics & hospitality

blocks.p: The Purchaser or their representative will be available to advance the show by phone or email no later than **ten business days** before the performance, confirming: chosen format; fee, capacity, ticket pricing and any tax withheld; stage size and condition of sound and lighting; parking, internet, green room access and exits; day-of contact; and times for load-in, sound-check, performance and curfew.

The name is **Morphics** — one word, as written here — in all printed advertising and mentioned in any radio or social advertising. For support slots it is listed, published and promoted in full. It is never shortened or restyled.

list: Access at the contracted load-in time, and for 45 minutes after curfew for load-out when headlining.
Free parking at the venue, or as close as possible.
A competent driver between airport, hotel and venue where contracted.
All-access credentials for Artist, crew and management, for the duration of the event.

blocks.p: Comps as contracted; where unstated, **five**, two of them all-access — band, crew and management not counted against that total. Cash preferred. Cheques only with written approval from management in advance, payable to **Morphics LLC**. Where management travels with the Artist, the Purchaser settles with management. Please provide a private space for settlement.
Morphics typically travels alone; confirm numbers at advance. Contracted meals are served one hour before the performance or 30 minutes after. In the green room before arrival:

list: Bottled water, sufficient for Artist and any crew.
Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, or a bar tab on site.
A meal, before the show or at the venue.
Safe, on-time transport to and from the necessary locations.

blocks.p: Where a meal cannot be provided, a **$30** buyout per person applies.

Where provided: a double room at a three-star hotel, B&B or similar, close to the venue, booked for late arrival and late check-out, available until the day after the performance. The Purchaser is not responsible for incidentals. Where a hotel was contracted but not provided, a **$175** buyout applies at settlement.

page3.closingNote: Anything here can be discussed — raise it at advance rather than on the day. Nearly everything is negotiable with notice; almost nothing is, without it. **{contact} · {email}**

checklist: Performance format — A/V, Ableton or DJ
Booth width, and deck count you can host
Sound engineer on site for the full set
Load-in, sound-check, set and curfew times
